blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine National Police (PNP) is investigating the source of a “fake report” alleging a mass shooting at De La Salle University-Dasmariñas in Cavite on Thursday. PNP chief Police Gen. Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr. said Friday that the probe would determine who was behind the report and whether it was deliberately fabricated.
